name: Federal Infrastructure Regulations and Powers
description:
This law defines certain regulations for work done in highways, protections for various federal infrastructure and districts, and special powers for workers; including:

* Regulations on bridge materials to comply with SC and C law.
* Interactions with Federal Utilities are restricted to %Federal Utility Worker%
* A QoL provision that allows vehicle  placement for everyone on owned propery.
* Gives %Federal Engineers% towing powers in Federal infra Districts.
* Generally protects Lasers and their towers from tampering.
* Protects Infra related districts from being claimed over by unauthorized persons.

=====================================
USAGE ADVICE FOR MOIS
=====================================

This laws gives MoI a few useful districts and titles that can be used.
[Federal Utilities] can be used to setup areas for power plants, pumping stations, and the like. The title %Federal Utility Worker% allows interactions in [Federal Utilities], and also allows the placement and removal of power poles, pipes, and lights in the federal roads. No payment is provided for this by default.
[National Waster Center] defines areas for garbage dumps and recyling centers and restricts access to %Waste Manager%.
[Federally Approved Tunnel] is for protecting approved tunneling projects from being claimed over, it does not offer anything beyond that.

=====================================
TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION
=====================================
This law functions standalone but is usually used with 'Federal Infrastructure Payments'
It is mutually exlcusive to its predcessors 'Highway Payments Part 2' and 'Ecologicical and Laser Protection Act'. The former is entirely replace by this law and the latter is replaced by 'Ecological Protections'

Full documentation: https://discord.com/channels/254025510651297802/1544685594251104276
